status: source-and-ci-verified; release build and real-device validation are separate gates

evidence.claim: Application has a responsive semantic shell and task-priority hierarchy.
evidence.verification: Source contains responsive layouts, visible focus indicators, reduced-motion and forced-colors handling, grouped task selection, task focus metadata and local Mentor history.

evidence.claim: Offline mode does not request an AI-generated band.
evidence.verification: Unit and HTTP integration tests verify no band in local preflight and opt-out provider behavior.

evidence.claim: Provider adapter supports three native API shapes with response bounds.
evidence.verification: Mock tests cover OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages, Gemini generateContent, request deadlines through body reading and oversized responses.

evidence.claim: Desktop settings never persist API key plaintext and local writes reject cross-origin requests.
evidence.verification: HTTP integration tests check settings responses/files, Host/Origin policy and local-only opt-out.

evidence.claim: Desktop utility process receives a constrained environment and navigation only remains on the explicit local origin.
evidence.verification: Tests verify sensitive environment variables are not inherited and navigation rejects untrusted origins.

evidence.claim: Backup import rejects malformed or out-of-scope data and rechecks source evidence.
evidence.verification: Tests check schema and size bounds, known task IDs, bounded conversation roles and case-sensitive quote validation; credentials/settings are not imported.

evidence.claim: Task bank has broad practice coverage and stable learning metadata.
evidence.verification: Tests assert task ID uniqueness, valid task types, prompt/goal/tips, difficulty, time and skill focus.

evidence.claim: Production-built UI has no remote script or stylesheet URL.
Dependency installs are lockfile-based and high-severity advisory checks run in CI.
evidence.verification: CI uses npm ci and npm audit --audit-level=high.

evidence.claim: Assessment history is bound to the actual submitted snapshot even while the UI might otherwise be edited.
evidence.verification: The submission flow locks the editor/task selector during the request and record factory tests preserve the submitted task/prompt/essay rather than later UI state.

evidence.claim: Local HTTP endpoints reject unsupported body types, oversized request bodies and encoded traversal paths.
evidence.verification: Integration tests assert 415 for unsupported media types, 413 for a request over the configured cap and 403 for an encoded traversal path.

evidence.claim: Desktop runtime refuses to present a renderer unless the local server passes a token-authenticated readiness check on a randomly allocated loopback port.
evidence.verification: The desktop chooses an ephemeral loopback port, passes a random 256-bit hex startup token to the child runtime, and the health endpoint compares the supplied token before reporting readiness.

evidence.claim: The learning dashboard recommends concrete follow-up tasks from observed AI criteria without converting missing scores into zero.
evidence.verification: Tests cover starter plans, lowest-observed criterion selection, cross-task transfer and null/invalid scores; UI contract tests confirm the recommended task controls are wired.

evidence.claim: Release workflow checks platform artifacts and tags releases from the app version only after platform jobs pass.
evidence.verification: Contract tests assert publication dependencies, Windows/Linux/Android artifact gate, package-derived tag and read-only CI workflow permissions.

not_yet_verified: Visual browser screenshot review across desktop and mobile viewports
Installation and launch on real Windows, Linux and Android devices
Live requests against user-configured providers and actual billing measurements
Band agreement against an independent expert-rated essay corpus
Third-party penetration test or formal security certification
